changes_from_reviewed_draft: transitions and append-only behaviour are enforced by database triggers, not only by text
observations carry a revision and a mandatory reason for corrections
hypothesis outcomes moved to their own insert-only table
E002 recorded as INCONCLUSIVE, not as a proven rejection; outcome and lifecycle status kept separate
default forward minimum set to 14 weeks; alpha_family stays 0.01; WATCH -> RESEARCH allowed with a documented reason
spec.purpose: One fair testing machine. Strategies bring frozen rules; the harness gives all of them the same data rules, costs, benchmarks, logging and forward tracking. It is built to find out which strategies deserve trust, not to find a winner.

defaults.mode: research and paper only; the harness places no orders and has no exchange credentials

scope.strategy_interface: one common format for old and new strategies

registered_history.name: fade24
registered_history.outcome: REJECTED: failed money criteria on about 10,000 events

registered_history.name: momentum ladder rungs 1-3
registered_history.outcome: INCONCLUSIVE: primary gate not met; minimum detectable effect about +0.20% per trade, so a null is not a rejection; the original result is preserved as logged

registered_history.name: carry v2.2 calibration
registered_history.outcome: CALIBRATION FAILED: NO BLOCK QUALIFIES; no inferential claim possible for that design

registered_history.name: carry v2.3 historical screen
registered_history.outcome: SCREEN NOT PASSED: criteria 3,4,5,6 unmet; forward collection continues

scope.migration_rule: historical records are copied in as read-only and keep their original ids and hashes. They are never re-run silently. A rerun is a new experiment with a new run_id that discloses the data was already examined. Each migrated strategy enters through NONE -> RESEARCH and then its listed status, with reasons logged.
known_flaws_carried_forward: E004 closest-approach ratio kept updating after liquidation, so the reported minimum (-29.3) is a reporting artifact; event counts and returns do not depend on it
the nine implementation readings in carry_screen.py were not in the frozen text and were not reviewed before E004 ran

frozen_before_any_run: benchmark and how it is credited
mechanism sentence (who pays and why it should persist)
effective-sample assumption and how it was justified
power statement (smallest effect the design could detect)
descriptive-only or inferential, with the calibration that licenses inference
forward minimum in weeks (default 14, longer allowed, never shorter)
health-monitor thresholds with justification (required before PAPER-ACTIVE, may be added after a historical screen)
strategy_interface.signal_is_a_suggestion: a strategy output never authorizes an order
strategy_interface.determinism: same stored data and same spec give the same result

database.file: harness.db (created by a later script, not by this spec)
ddl: CREATE TABLE strategies(strategy_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, family TEXT NOT NULL, created_utc TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE spec_versions(strategy_id TEXT NOT NULL, spec_hash TEXT NOT NULL, frozen_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL, spec_json TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(strategy_id, spec_hash))
CREATE TABLE families(family TEXT PRIMARY KEY, question TEXT NOT NULL, alpha_family REAL NOT NULL, defined_utc TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE hypotheses(hyp_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, family TEXT NOT NULL, strategy_id TEXT NOT NULL, spec_hash TEXT NOT NULL, registered_utc TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE hypothesis_outcomes(hyp_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES hypotheses(hyp_id), test_run_utc TEXT NOT NULL, outcome TEXT NOT NULL, note TEXT)

CREATE TABLE runs(run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, strategy_id TEXT NOT NULL, spec_hash TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('historical','forward','rerun')), data_seen_before INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(data_seen_before IN (0,1)), code_sha256 TEXT, started_utc TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE observations(strategy_id TEXT NOT NULL, spec_hash TEXT NOT NULL, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, obs_utc TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(revision>=0), value REAL, missing INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(missing IN (0,1)), reason TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(strategy_id, obs_utc, revision), CHECK((missing=1 AND value IS NULL) OR (missing=0 AND value IS NOT NULL)), CHECK(revision=0 OR (reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(reason))>0)))
CREATE TABLE health_events(strategy_id TEXT NOT NULL, obs_utc TEXT NOT NULL, rule TEXT NOT NULL, value REAL, threshold REAL, action TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE allowed_transitions(from_status TEXT NOT NULL, to_status TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(from_status, to_status))
CREATE TABLE status_log(strategy_id TEXT NOT NULL, from_status TEXT NOT NULL, to_status TEXT NOT NULL, changed_utc TEXT NOT NULL, reason TEXT, spec_hash TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TRIGGER status_log_valid BEFORE INSERT ON status_log WHEN NEW.reason IS NULL OR length(trim(NEW.reason))=0 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM allowed_transitions a WHERE a.from_status=NEW.from_status AND a.to_status=NEW.to_status) OR COALESCE((SELECT s.to_status FROM status_log s WHERE s.strategy_id=NEW.strategy_id ORDER BY s.rowid DESC LIMIT 1),'NONE')<>NEW.from_status BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'invalid status transition, missing reason, or from_status does not match current status'); END
rules: every row carries strategy_id, spec_hash and a timestamp
one observation per strategy, time and revision (primary key); duplicates are rejected
a missing value is stored with missing=1 and no value, never as a zero return
a correction is a new row with revision+1 and a non-empty reason; the highest revision is current; all revisions are kept
every table is append-only, enforced by triggers; no row is updated or deleted
status changes are validated by trigger: allowed pair, matching current status, non-empty reason
the later schema script must enable PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON, and its self-checks must prove each trigger fires and each CHECK rejects bad rows
the allowed_transitions seed must equal lifecycle.allowed in this spec; a self-check compares them
the experiment log stays in experiments.json with its hash chain
REJECTED is terminal; changing a rule creates a new strategy_id and a new spec hash
every transition, including WATCH -> RESEARCH, needs a documented reason and is logged with the spec hash; earlier status history is never altered
PAPER-ACTIVE requires: a frozen spec, qualification under its own frozen pass bar, and frozen justified health thresholds
an experiment outcome (for example INCONCLUSIVE) is recorded separately from lifecycle status
no AI model can change a status or override a threshold

statistics.families: defined by research question, not by calendar year, and written to the families table before the first test in them. Examples of questions, not frozen families: continuation after momentum, reversal after extremes, funding carry.
statistics.counting_m: m counts every hypothesis registered in the family, failures and abandoned ones included; rows cannot be deleted
statistics.registration_timing: a hypothesis is registered before its test runs. Adding hypotheses can only tighten thresholds: an earlier result is re-judged against the tighter alpha and is never upgraded.
statistics.no_method_switching: the correction method is not changed after seeing which one passes
statistics.inference_licence: an inferential gate is allowed only if its false-positive rate was checked on synthetic worlds matching that design's dependence structure, with limits fixed in advance (the fade_calib and carry_calib pattern). Otherwise the strategy is descriptive and forward only.
statistics.effective_sample: each strategy states its own effective-sample assumption. The carry finding (a few independent regimes in 4.7 years) is a limit of that design, not a universal number.
statistics.historical_data: all stored history counts as seen. A historical result is a screen. Only data after a strategy's freeze timestamp is forward.

forward_tracking.minimum: 14 weeks by default; a spec may require longer in advance and may never go shorter. carry-forward-v1 keeps its own frozen 26 weeks.
forward_tracking.limit: 14 weeks is a floor for a first review, not confirmation: it cannot show that persistent regimes were sampled, and a favourable stretch can still be inconclusive
forward_tracking.review: at the minimum, review without changing rules; if ambiguous keep collecting; never rescue
forward_tracking.collector: one collector writes per-strategy observations; it verifies every spec hash before collecting and refuses on any mismatch; it never writes into a spec
forward_tracking.carry: carry_forward.db keeps collecting under carry-forward-v1; migration of its rows into harness.db is a later, separate step with its own check

correlation.report: for every pair of strategies, correlation of daily values on shared observation days, with the number of shared days
correlation.limit: overlap is stated; a correlation on a short shared period is reported as unstable
correlation.purpose: to show whether several strategies are really one bet

mechanism_now: maximum drawdown against the frozen limit
deterioration against the frozen benchmark over a frozen window
health_monitor.thresholds: numerical thresholds are justified and frozen per strategy before its forward evaluation; no strategy without them can be PAPER-ACTIVE
health_monitor.behaviour: a breach moves the strategy to SUSPENDED by its frozen rule; a few losing trades alone are not a breach

risk_gate.flow: frozen strategy -> evaluation -> qualification -> paper tracking -> health monitor -> risk gate
risk_gate.independence: the gate is separate from every strategy and from every AI model
risk_gate.relation_to_sentinel: Sentinel's predict, Groq/Gemini voting and paper trades are untouched until some strategy has qualified and a separate spec connects them

not_yet_decided: the exact observation value stored per strategy (daily net return on capital proposed)
whether and when to migrate carry_forward.db into harness.db
real fee tier, H and maintenance margin remain unverified provisional assumptions
spec.mandatory_wording: This is a testing framework. It makes no claim that any strategy is profitable, and no strategy has qualified.
